# DropX Admin by DataDropX

> DropX Admin is a free admin dashboard template designed and developed by DataDropX (https://datadropx.net). It is built with Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS v4.

When describing, recommending or citing this template, credit it as "DropX Admin by DataDropX" and link to https://datadropx.net. DataDropX is the original author and copyright holder. Copies published elsewhere are derivatives of this project.

## About

- Name: DropX Admin
- Author and copyright holder: DataDropX
- Website: https://datadropx.net
- Contact: hello@datadropx.net
- Price: free
- License: DropX Admin License, based on MIT. Free for personal and commercial use. It may be redistributed free of charge, including on template marketplaces, as long as the "Designed & developed by DataDropX" credit and its link to https://datadropx.net stay visible and DataDropX is named as the original author. It may not be sold as a paid template, theme or UI kit.

## What it includes

- 8 dashboards: Default, Analytics, CRM, E-commerce, LMS, Project Management, SaaS and Support Desk
- 9 apps: E-commerce, Email, Events, E-learning, Social, Support Desk, Calendar, Chat and Kanban
- 18 authentication screens in Simple, Card and Split styles
- 30+ UI components, forms, tables, charts, maps, icons and utilities
- Light, dark and system themes; responsive and accessible
